tools.name: generate_wedding_crossword
tools.description: Build a complete connected crossword with numbered clues, its answer grid, and a 24-hour link to edit and print. Supply 2–12 different answers with 2–20 letters each. Latin accents and spaces are normalized to grid letters; spell out numbers and dates.

tools.name: find_wedding_templates
tools.description: Find My Wed Paper wedding newspaper templates, real previews, and available four- or eight-page editions. Filter by a template ID or page count.

tools.name: get_printing_guide
tools.description: Read current My Wed Paper guidance for paper dimensions, print files, and home or professional printing. Select US Letter, A4, or Newspaper Club digital tabloid.
